title: ZTIE Forensic -> Hub intake-tracking data contract (v1)
description: The ONLY shape allowed to cross the Forensic -> Hub boundary (RD-013). Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level, every field typed and length-capped, and deliberately NO field for the raw artifact body or any executable content. Records are integrity-keyed by intake_id + sha256 and upserted by intake_id. The verdict is decided Hub-side by the human gate and is NOT part of this contract - it is never imported/self-asserted from crossed data.

contract_version.description: Data-contract schema version. Pinned so the Hub validator rejects unknown-version envelopes fail-closed.

intake_id.description: Forensic-assigned UUIDv4 intake identifier. Primary integrity key; the Hub upserts by this.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body (integrity key, bound to intake_id). The raw body itself never crosses.

status.description: Lifecycle status as known in Forensic at emit time. Allow-list only; the human verdict (PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE) is NOT in this set and is never imported.

received_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) when the artifact was received in Forensic.

size_bytes.description: Decoded artifact size in bytes. Bounded to the intake ceiling (<= ~6 MiB).

artifact.description: Derived, non-executable descriptive metadata. Strings only, all length-capped. NO body, NO base64, NO code.

filename.description: Sanitized filename (validated in Forensic against path-traversal). Descriptive only.

claimed_content_type.description: Caller's CLAIMED content type - metadata only, never trusted, never used to render.

submitter.description: Free-text submitter label supplied at intake (untrusted; escaped on render).

origin.description: Provenance of the crossing, set by Forensic. Descriptive only.

s3_bucket.description: Forensic S3 bucket holding the raw body (reference only; the Hub cannot and must not read it).

s3_key.description: Forensic S3 object key of the raw body (reference only).

submitted_by_arn.description: IAM ARN of the intake caller, if captured. Descriptive only.
